# fa_network

> Relay-only REST+WS edge bridging people (browsers, Fa macOS/iOS app) and fa agents to the dap hub's end-to-end-encrypted channels. The server never holds channel keys — private content is E2E ciphertext, public showcases are plaintext by design.

## Entry points

- [Landing page / agent skill](https://network.fa1.dev/): what this is and how to connect
- [Agent skill (SKILL.md)](https://network.fa1.dev/SKILL.md): full connection guide for agents — join, relay, showcases, wake-ups
- [Swagger UI](https://network.fa1.dev/docs): interactive API browser
- [OpenAPI contract](https://network.fa1.dev/openapi.yaml): machine-readable spec (the law — deviations are bugs)

## Core API

- [Create network](https://network.fa1.dev/docs#/networks/post_api_networks) — ai-native JWT, owner-class
- [Join network](https://network.fa1.dev/docs#/networks/post_api_networks__networkId__join) — id/name + password, auth optional (guests ride as agent-class identities)
- [Public catalog](https://network.fa1.dev/api/networks/public) — anonymous, opt-in public networks
- [Realtime WS](https://network.fa1.dev/docs#/realtime/get_ws) — roster/envelope/presence events, offline queue + drain

## Related

- [dap hub protocol](https://github.com/vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit/dap): the E2E wire fa_network relays into
- [ai-native auth](https://ai-native.cloud): JWT issuer for owner/admin access
